style.components: one reusable component per widget kind, configured by props
style.state: one createStore for the whole dashboard, shared through a context; widgets use path setters on their slice
style.externalEvents: store.receive(msg); serverSet and snapshot through reconcile(…, { key: 'id' })
style.derived: plain functions; createMemo for the filtered list
style.events: onClick/onInput (delegated), onChange for checkboxes and selects
style.build: Vite + vite-plugin-solid, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.architecture: TEA with Browser.element: one Model record (a field per widget), one update, one view
style.components: shared components: one module per widget kind (Model, Msg, Config, update, view, decoder), written once; per widget only a Config value, a Model field and a Msg constructor wrapping its kind's Msg, routed in update, the decoders and view (Html.map)
style.configuration: a Config record per widget; rules and formats built with the kind module's helpers (Field.required/minLength/matching, Amount.currency/percent/unit)
style.externalEvents: one incoming port; Json.Decode into the app's messages (serverSet → the widget's Replaced, notify → Feed.Notified, tick → Tick, snapshot → GotSnapshot)
style.lists: Html.Keyed for todo, filter and feed
style.derived: computed in view (summary lines, todo left, filter matches)
style.events: onInput for text inputs and the select, onClick for buttons and checkboxes, a number-only input decoder for the amount
style.build: elm make --optimize, then uglify-js compress (pure_funcs) and mangle passes, as the Elm guide recommends

compression.js: minified by the framework's production build

attribution: source maps: node_modules → runtime; unmapped bundler output → tooling (counted with runtime); the adapter file → adapter (excluded); everything else → app. Brotli split: runtime = brotli(runtime+tooling); app = brotli(app JS) − runtime.
